prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, except for Round 6 where the prediction was too low.
Evidence is still thin for finish new_screen changes due to mixed results across 3 tests (1 test won, 2 showed no clear effect).
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen changes (only 1 test, which performed worse).
Evidence is still thin for adoption wait_info changes (only 1 test, which showed no clear effect).
Evidence is still thin for finish redesign changes (only 1 test, which performed worse).
Evidence is still thin for sign_in reorder changes (only 1 test, which showed no clear effect).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -5.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, wait_info: +1.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.9% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -7.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 76.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Time Progress Display: Add visual progress tracking and time estimation components to the waiting screen while desktop pet generation completes. (why: Support mails highlight pets failing to open or showing desktop launch stalls, and home wait step averages 2336s mean time.)
1: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Reassurance Guidance Hint: Display an inline hint on choose_path explaining that pet path choices can be changed later from app settings. (why: Mean time on choose_path is 514s, showing users stall due to fear of making an unchangeable starting choice.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Data Protection Hint: Add an explicit persistence hint on sign_in explaining that account creation saves pet data to the cloud. (why: 8 support emails were received regarding pets missing or resetting after signing back in.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification: Enable desktop notification alerts when companion pet generation finishes on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting mean time is 2336s, indicating users minimize or abandon the desktop app while background rendering completes.)
4: [finish, incentive] Finish Step Quick Start Action Buttons: Add an interactive action button on home_intro encouraging immediate first pet interaction on desktop. (why: 76% completion at finish step with high mean time (5815s) and user confusion on post-onboarding controls.)
